name: Pokémon Heart & Soul — Exploration Prototype
description: HnS v2.0.6 development port: HnS intro/title, day/night and Fake RTC, native-species followers, source battle terrain and Gen 3/4 healthboxes, battle pacing and shortcuts, compatible expanded level/egg moves, source stats and persistent status migration. Escape Rope and source font repairs. Full expanded effects/abilities and later campaign remain in progress. Requires imported vanilla Emerald.
